public_rationale: Developer adoption makes substantial integration demand plausible. Anthropic's direct paid chat product also shows why integration dependence cannot be assumed from its business model alone. Neither source supplies the revenue composition or customer retention needed to judge heavy dependence for both providers. The financial evidence found does not match the required period and customer-use categories closely enough to settle the claim.
limitations: A substantial minority revenue stream could still create heavy dependence.
The selected quarter is a reporting proxy for the publication-time observation.
The unspecified accounting basis prevents a decisive financial comparison under the assessment rules.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI and Anthropic depend heavily on companies believing they must integrate AI, which requires finding integrations users care about.

statement.excerpt: As it stands, OpenAI and Anthropic are heavily dependent on companies believing that they have to integrate AI into their products, which will require these companies to be able to find ways to integrate AI that users actually care about.

from_speaker: companies believing that they have to integrate AI into their products
integrate AI that users actually care about
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is substantial commercial reliance by each provider on companies embedding its models in products.
Heavy dependence does not necessarily mean a majority of revenue. No percentage threshold is supplied.
Internal workplace use and direct chatbot subscriptions are not automatically third-party product integrations.

Use 2023-10-01 through 2023-12-31, the latest completed calendar quarter before publication, as the reporting-period proxy for 'As it stands'. This period is an evaluator choice, not an explicit date in the claim.
Revenue composition, retention and customer concentration can test commercial dependence. They cannot directly establish customers' private beliefs.
The source supplies no financial accounting basis.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records for the target period show substantial reliance by both OpenAI and Anthropic on third-party product integrations, with customer evidence connecting continued demand to useful integrations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish that at least one provider was not substantially dependent on third-party product integrations. Merely having another revenue channel is insufficient.

evidence.explanation: This reports substantial developer adoption during the target quarter. Developer counts do not measure revenue dependence or show which uses were product integrations; a news report is used for the conference statement.
Anthropic offered a direct paid chat product before the target quarter. This alternative channel does not establish its revenue share or disprove heavy dependence on integrations.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Comparable records for the target quarter showing each provider's integration-related revenue, concentration and retention, supported by evidence about customers' reasons for purchasing.
